$comment: Tool synergy graph for the {a}OS stack (task-0304). Nodes are whitepaper primary tools; edges are native integrations, each tagged with its wire and a source URL. Built 2026-08-01 from the verified whitepaper research. Consumed by the proposal's integration story; UI wiring is a later ticket.

edges.what: Docling document reader ships as a native LlamaIndex integration, so parsed PDFs and office docs flow straight into indexing
LlamaIndex ships a first party Qdrant vector store integration
Mem0 supports Qdrant as its vector store backend
Mem0 keeps its history store in SQLite by default
llama.cpp serves an OpenAI style endpoint that LiteLLM routes as a provider, giving the free local lane a place in the gateway
LiteLLM logs every routed call to Langfuse via its logging integration, so gateway traffic lands in the trace store
LiteLLM pre call hooks can consult an external policy endpoint before a request is allowed through
LiteLLM's guardrails framework runs LLM Guard scans on requests passing through the proxy
Eval runs read traced generations and write scores back, connecting judgment to the trace store
DeepEval judge models point at any OpenAI compatible endpoint, so the gateway serves the judges too
Pydantic AI talks to OpenAI compatible providers, so typed agents ride the same gateway and OAuth lanes
Pydantic AI emits OpenTelemetry instrumentation that lands in any OTLP endpoint including Langfuse
FastMCP servers expose Python orchestration as tools any MCP client, including Claude Code and the fleet, can call
The official Playwright MCP server lets agents drive the same browser stack the ghost tour walks trust
Composio's integration catalog surfaces as MCP tool servers for agent clients
Dagu ships a built in MCP server so agents can inspect and trigger scheduled jobs
gVisor's runsc hardens the container runtime that tool servers and agent-run code execute inside
Durable workflow steps wrap agent calls, so a crashed overnight loop resumes from its last completed step
Machine secrets inject as environment variables into the gateway and services, so keys stop living in files
Orchestration asks OPA for an allow or deny decision over plain HTTP before risky tool calls
AG-UI is the shared wire for agent to UI events; CopilotKit is its reference implementation and assistant-ui speaks it
The chat UI streams from any OpenAI compatible backend, which the gateway provides
Voice pipelines call local models for the offline lane, keeping the assistive voice loop alive with zero network
Scheduled jobs ping their check on completion; silence becomes an external page instead of an unnoticed death
Graph memory backends connect the runtime knowledge graph to agent memory for relationship aware recall
